hypothesis_to_confirm: The 'bounded recovery with observed Chromium DOM' tests use the default 5 s per-test timeout while each runs real-Chromium recovery attempts; browserRecovery.ts enforces a production 5 s attempt deadline and 1 s element timeouts, so under load the attempt is cancelled by its own deadline and returns false.
pattern_to_copy: PR #599 (OVD-633, worker/src/adapters/xometry.test.ts): deferred-based sequencing with exact counts; red-first with a SIGSTOP/SIGCONT stall harness (stallrun.sh/inject.sh idea: freeze the vitest process group 150-300 ms every 350-500 ms); mutations M1-M3 killed.
acceptance: A1 Red first: at least one failure reproduced on the UNMODIFIED test under the stall harness or an injected event-loop stall; command and captured output in the PR body.
A2 Root cause confirmed or corrected in the body (which timer/deadline interaction fails under load).

A3 Fix in the tests: await observable state instead of fixed timers; per-test timeouts raised only on real-browser paths with the reason stated; serialize the real-browser files only if they contend for the runner; if a seam is added to browserRecovery.ts, defaults unchanged and pinned by a test.
A4 Green: 20 consecutive passes of `npx vitest run worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.test.ts` under the same load as A1; output in the body.
A5 Mutations: reintroduce the fixed timer -> fails; drop the awaited state check -> fails; (if a seam exists) change a production default -> the defaults test fails. All captured.
A6 `npm --prefix worker run verify`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` pass locally.

A7 Draft PR with base codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003, title starting 'OVD-636: ', body per the repository PR template with A1-A6 evidence and hosted run ids, stating that merge goes into the integration branch and that the production apply is protected; no release-parent identifiers (OVD-520, OVD-527, OVD-319, OVD-419, OVD-199, OVD-359, OVD-332, OVD-385) anywhere; no Linear closing word before an issue id.
